tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Enterococcus faecalis (>100,000 CFU/mL), indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria; consider further evaluation for glycemic status. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
